scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the porch lantern arch for tonight's walk sendoff after supplies and timing are set.
Emerging Need: The setup attempt begins on the porch, then stops when a cracked corner key leaves the same folding arch unable to stand.
Decision Context: Stored arch-repair notes identify the matching no-cost corner-key hold, deadline, and limits on not authorizing paid or altered hardware.
Consequence: Timely handling could restart the interrupted setup before guests gather; after the same-day pull sheet closes, the arch cannot be restored for tonight.

parameter.title: Friday lantern-walk porch sendoff
parameter.description: Porch meet-up before the neighborhood lantern walk; Lucia plans to raise her blue folding arch and hang battery lanterns for photos before stepping off.
Battery lantern clips and twine for the folding arch at tonight's porch sendoff.

parameter.content: I'm on the porch and started raising the blue folding arch now. The lower corner key cracked when I tightened it; the frame folds back down if I let go, so the lantern clips and twine can't go up. I've laid it flat again so it doesn't bend more.

parameter.subject: Today's frame-parts pull sheet is closed
parameter.body: Member notice: the 2:30 p.m. same-day pull sheet has closed. Removable corner-key kits and arch hardware requested after this notice will be held for the next open pickup day, not for Friday afternoon.
